comment: Third-party boot components. Each package is downloaded from the official Ubuntu archive and verified against the pinned SHA-256 before use. Update all entries together and re-run the VM test suite. 'source' names the Ubuntu source packages (name: version) a binary was built from, the one with the code first; 'shipped' marks what goes onto every drive (its source must be offered with each release).

shim-signed.license: BSD-2-Clause (shim); signed by Microsoft UEFI CA
shim-signed.use: UEFI first stage (Secure Boot capable): /usr/lib/shim/shimx64.efi.signed.latest, MokManager mmx64.efi
shim-signed.name: shim

grub-efi-amd64-signed.use: UEFI second stage: loads the Distro Buny runtime kernel
grub-efi-amd64-signed.name: GRUB

linux-modules.use: runtime kernel modules (storage, input, file systems)
linux-modules.name: Linux kernel modules

grub-pc-bin.use: legacy BIOS boot (optional): boot.img and core.img modules
grub-pc-bin.name: GRUB (BIOS)

exfatprogs.use: tests only: reference fsck.exfat for checking generated data partitions (not shipped)
exfatprogs.name: exfatprogs

mtools.use: tests only: independent FAT reader for inspecting generated ESPs (not shipped)
mtools.name: mtools

busybox-static.use: runtime emergency shell and diagnostics (static BusyBox)
busybox-static.name: BusyBox
